title: Guard Wine runtime access before leasing the shared prefix
changes: Refuse Wine validation before acquiring the shared prefix lease when the existing XDG Wine runtime directory is not writable, preventing the observed sandbox failure from retaining a prefix lease.

Recover only the failed aadspz22 unit and prefix leases after matching their owner tokens, checking host-visible process activity and successfully draining the Wine server; preserve both original owner records in a recovery receipt.
validation: Wine-mode sandbox preflight wine-runtime-preflight-6120e8eq refuses the read-only runtime before launching Wine and records no retained unit or prefix lease.
Wine wine-runtime-recovery-smoke-lwzsvfgf runs a harmless Windows Python command against the managed prefix, passes and records a completed Wine server drain.
limitations: The preflight covers an existing XDG Wine runtime directory only and does not grant sandbox access or prevent other runtime, race or filesystem failures. The paused ROM-data validation remains unrun. Automatic approval review availability is external to the project.
